tells: B's desk lamp shade is a flat white cylinder with no emission, no translucency glow, no cast pool on the desk; A's lamp is lit, shows warm gradient through the shade and a hot spot on the desktop

B's ceiling downlight is a clean-edged flat white disc with a uniform cream ceiling around it and no bloom, no lens flare, no falloff on the drywall; A's fixture clips with soft roll-off and lights the ceiling around it
B's task chair reads as a low-poly asset: hard-edged armrest boxes, seat cushion with no fabric weave or wrinkle, uniform anti-aliased edges, floating without contact shadow into the carpet
B's carpet is a flat tiled texture with zero pile or specular response; A's carpet shows pile direction, colour noise, and darkens toward the far wall
B's door edge and closet panel are dead-black, dead-straight with a hard blue-lit 3D-app edge highlight; A's door frame has a real jamb, trim profile, hinge and slightly bowed edges
B's mattress and box spring are a single smooth beige block with no quilting, no piping, no gravity sag; A shows quilted top, welt seams and slight sag
B's window is a flat uniform pale blue plane with no exterior detail or brightness gradient; A shows blown-out sky with an atmospheric gradient
B's roller shade pattern is perfectly planar and crisply mapped with no texture ripple; A's shade shows slight perspective bow and softness
B's wide FOV stretches the near shelving and pendant, with no barrel distortion, chroma fringing, grain, or vignette; A carries phone-camera softness, noise in the dark carpet, and corner falloff
B has almost no site clutter or wear (no outlet cover, no wall marks, no seams); A shows an outlet, panel bevel, baseboard and slight scuffs
critics.biggestGap: The desk lamp in B: it is a dead, unlit white cylinder with a matte shade and a shadowless base. In A the same lamp is switched on, the shade glows with a warm gradient (brighter at the bottom rim, translucent falloff up the drum), it throws a warm elliptical pool onto the light-oak desktop and a soft contact shadow under the base. Make the shade an emissive translucent material with subsurface glow, add the warm cast light on the desk and a small ground contact shadow; a lamp that is lit anchors the whole scene's light transport and is the first thing a viewer's eye lands on at the desk.
secondaryGaps: Ceiling downlight in B: replace the flat white disc with a clipped emissive source that blooms softly, brightens the surrounding drywall with a falloff gradient, and shows a slight trim shadow; match A's roll-off.

Task chair in B: replace the low-poly asset with a proper chair model (mesh back, seat cushion with fabric weave normal map and slight compression wrinkles, rounded armrest edges), and add a contact shadow under the base into the carpet.
Carpet in B: the tiled texture needs pile direction, subtle fibre specular, colour variation between tiles and a darker, noisier falloff toward the far room as in A; kill the visible repeat.

Bed in B: add quilted mattress top with welt seams, a visible mattress/box spring split with slightly different textures, and gravitational sag of the mattress edge; A's bed has stitching and pillow-top softness.

Camera signature in B: add mild barrel distortion, luminance grain that rises in the dark carpet, faint vignette, and slightly softer focus at the frame edges; also add a real outlet cover, baseboard shadow seam and slight wall scuffs to give the walls history.
